name: stack
description: Stacks its children vertically with one consistent gap between them.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space between children. A pair such as sm-lg grows fluidly from the first stop to the second.

attributes.name: data-fill
attributes.description: Make the stack at least as tall as the viewport, so a child carrying data-split reaches the bottom.

children.description: Anything. Each child's margins are reset; the stack owns the space between them.
At most one child may carry data-split; it and everything after it are pushed to the end of the stack when the stack is taller than its content.

tokens.name: --yeti-cover-height
tokens.description: The minimum block size when data-fill is set.

a11y.notes: Purely visual. Reading order is source order.
